summary: This plugin provides an MCP management panel in the DSH sidebar to visually inspect, add, edit, remove, and enable or disable MCP server configurations, with changes persisted to the host profile configuration.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing DSH configuration management panel for MCP servers, enabling visual CRUD and enable/disable operations on profile patch entries. Evidence shows it edits `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` entries in `cordis.patch.yml`, supports MCP transport fields and env metadata display, and provides save-to-reload behavior within the host/session lifecycle, while also handling a bundled Node execution fallback for `npx`.
